blocks.html: We love having you in the clinic and kindly ask that you respect our scheduling policies. Please note that we require 24 hours notice for all cancellations in order to avoid cancellation fees.
If you miss an appointment with no notification, we charge 100% of the service total.
If you give less than 24 hours notice, you will be required to pay 50% of your service total.
If you need to reschedule your appointment, we encourage you to give us a call at the clinic+1 (403) 454-5607 or alter your booking via our booking system.
